The '''Nilgaria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Nilgarian worm]]s.<ref name="Goatgrass" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nilgaria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
